newsitem.title: INDIA: OPINION-WEEKLY TECHNICAL OUTLOOK FOR BOMBAY STOCKS.
newsitem.headline: OPINION-WEEKLY TECHNICAL OUTLOOK FOR BOMBAY STOCKS.

text.p: The following technical analysis of the 30-share Bombay Stock Exchange index has been prepared by Dharmesh Rajdev, analyst at SMIFS Securities on November 4:
After facing a resistance at 3315-3345 band the sensex resumed its southward journey last week breaking important support levels. Thus the fall from 4130 to 2930 has been retraced by 34.60 percent.

Now, in the recent rally, if we assume 3345 to be the top, then the sensex would have risen by 415 points. The important support levels at least for the short term could emerge at 50 percent or 61.8 percent retracement levels in the current downtrend. The retracement levels work out at 3137.50 and 3088.53.

The sensex has already pierced the 50 percent retracement mark and is inching towards the 3000 zone. This is the area where a minor bottom is expected to be created and short rally towards the middle of the week will again provide bears an opportunity to indulge into a quick trade.

During the last week, the sensex opened at 3308.95 and touched the high of 3314.05. From here it turned down sharply to the low of 3122.76 before closing the week at 3146.06. Thus there was a net loss of 104.6 points. At this juncture the short term first weekly stochastic oscillator is placed at 54.18 with its trigger at 44.11.
While the medium term slow stochastic oscillator is placed at 25.02. Here the indicator has just come out of the oversold zone signifying minor support at 3000-3050 zone.

The eight-week moving average is at 3218.08 and it is falling. While the 25-week moving average is at 3527.66. The sensex has not been able to close above the 8-week average - thus showing weakness of the market.

The daily 9-day moving average on "highs" is at 3265.73 while 9-day moving average on "lows" is at 3196.87. The sensex made the top of 3190.82. Thus the 9-day moving average on low will offer a resistance level on ascent.

On weekly terms the 9-week moving average on highs is at 3352.55 and the 9-week moving average on lows is at 3193.67. The sensex has closed below this level and is expected to continue its downward move this week.

With the 8-week moving average at 3218.08, the upper Bollinger band is at 3400 and the lower Bollinger Band at 3040. Since the sensex has closed below the 8-week moving average, it is expected to touch the lower Bollinger Band. Thus on the ascent the sensex is expected to touch the 3165-3217 band and on the descent the sensex is expected to touch the 3022-3075 band.
(The opinions expressed in this article reflect the views of the author only. They should not be taken as reflecting the views of Reuters).
